Class Reflection

java.lang.Object
org.aeonbits.owner.util.Reflection
public final class Reflection extends Object
The reflection this library needs and the JDK differences behind it: whether a method is a default one, how to invoke it on each baseline, and whether a class is on the class path.
Author:
Luigi R. Viggiano

    • isClassAvailable

      public static boolean isClassAvailable(String className)
      Checks whether a class with the given name is available on the classpath.
      Parameters:
      className - the fully qualified class name.
      Returns:
      true if the class can be loaded, false otherwise.

    • forName

      public static Class<?> forName(String className)
      Loads the class with the given name, returning null when it is not available.
      Parameters:
      className - the fully qualified class name.
      Returns:
      the Class object, or null if the class cannot be found.

    • isDefault

      public static boolean isDefault(Method method)
      Tells whether the given method is an interface default method.
      Parameters:
      method - the method to inspect.
      Returns:
      true if the method is a default method; false otherwise.

    • invokeDefaultMethod

      public static Object invokeDefaultMethod(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable
      Invokes a default method on the given proxy, dispatching to the interface implementation instead of going through the proxy invocation handler.
      Parameters:
      proxy - the proxy instance the method is invoked on.
      method - the default method to invoke.
      args - the arguments to pass to the method.
      Returns:
      the value returned by the invoked default method.
      Throws:
      Throwable - anything thrown by the invoked method.
